---
name: lab-manager-assistant
description: "Use when editing frontend pages/components and planning React/TypeScript architecture for the lab-manager project."
applyTo:
  - "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}"
  - "*.md"

This custom agent is tailored for the `lab-manager` workspace.

Use it when you need help with:
- frontend React/TypeScript component development in `src/`
- route, page, and UI flow implementation
- project architecture, data flow, and feature planning
- documentation updates for the app and design docs

Prefer direct workspace file edits and code guidance for this project. Avoid terminal commands unless explicitly requested.
